title: Power Solitaire
tagline: Three decks. Jacks high. No kings.
blurb: Klondike with a boost: A–J only, three 44-card decks, four suit wells that each climb A–J three times. Single cards in v0.

copy.playing: Tap a card, then a destination. JACK on empty.
